diagram3d.configuration.proportional_vec:
Coefficient to scale or reduce vectors linearly. Considering 
x the original size
P the proportional factor
Q the quadratic factor
The function is:
 Q * x^2 + P * x
diagram3d.configuration.quadratic_vector:
Coefficient to scale or reduce vectors quadratically. Considering 
x the original size
P the proportional factor
Q the quadratic factor
The function is:
 Q * x^2 + P * x
